title: ReceiptData
description: Canonical body serialized via OSPP Canonical Form (spec/06-security.md §4.8) and base64-encoded into the receipt.data field for ECDSA P-256 signing. Per 06-security.md §6.2. Discriminated (oneOf) by session type: the pass-form carries {offlinePassId, passCounter} (Full Offline / Partial B); the auth-form carries {authId, sessionId} (Partial A — ServerSignedAuth, no pass). Each form has 16 required fields plus optional meterValues (signed when present, omitted from the canonical body when absent). Four of the shared fields - stationId, endReason, bookedDurationSeconds and clockState - are signed only: they are carried in this body and in no envelope, and settlement reads them from here (spec/profiles/offline/reconciliation.md 8). `passCounter` (finding N7) is the pass's app-global usage counter, signed for global (offlinePassId, passCounter) uniqueness at reconcile; `authId`/`sessionId` (finding Q4) are the signed, non-spoofable Partial-A join key binding the buffered transaction to its ServerSignedAuth authorization. The digest signed by the station's private key is SHA-256 over the canonical bytes directly (NOT over the base64 form).

passCounter.description: Pass-form only. The pass's app-global monotonic usage counter (the value the app carried in OfflineAuthRequest.counter, echoed by the station). Signed (finding N7) so the server enforces global (offlinePassId, passCounter) uniqueness at reconcile. Distinct from txCounter (per-station boot counter).

authId.description: Auth-form (Partial A) only. The server-issued ServerSignedAuth authId this transaction reconciles against (mirrors the claim in server-signed-auth-claims.schema.json). Signed (finding Q4) so the join key is non-spoofable; the reconcile gate resolves it against the issued-authorization registry (reconciliation.md §6.1 check #4 auth-branch).

sessionId.description: Auth-form (Partial A) only. The server-issued session this transaction settles. Signed (finding Q4); paired with authId as the Partial-A join key.

deviceId.description: Device identifier from the BLE Hello / OfflinePass binding. Cryptographically binds the receipt to the device that authorized the pass.

stationId.description: The station that signed this receipt. It names the signer inside the signature, so the server resolves the receipt-signing key from the receipt itself, whichever copy of it arrives (06-security.md §6.2; spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md).

durationSeconds.description: Delivered duration in seconds, measured on the station's monotonic timer (profiles/core/heartbeat.md §6), not derived from startedAt and endedAt.

bookedDurationSeconds.description: The duration, in seconds, the station started the service for. Settlement by service kind reads it (spec/04-flows.md §6).

endReason.description: Why the session ended, with the meanings of the SessionEnded reason (spec/03-messages.md §5.4), and ServerStopped, which SessionEnded never carries: the server stopped the session with a StopService. A stop the customer requested over BLE (StopServiceRequest) is Local. Settlement by service kind reads it (spec/04-flows.md §6); a ServerStopped session settles as that section states for a stop the server issues.

clockState.description: State of the station's wall clock when it signed the receipt. Synchronized: set from the server's serverTime since the station last booted. Unsynchronized: not set from the server since the station last booted. The server corrects a receipt's times by the clock offset it measured at reconnection only when the receipt is Synchronized (spec/profiles/offline/reconciliation.md §6.8).

meterValues.description: Final meter readings. OPTIONAL — when present in the transaction payload, MUST be signed; when absent, MUST be omitted from the canonical body (implementations MUST NOT serialize an empty meterValues:{} or meterValues:null).
